lyrics.title: Sadness Is A Sickness
lyrics.text: sadness is a sickness and my sisters seem to suffer their loneliness so vicious it turns them against each other and all the small things that vex them, diminish all the things that connect them. apathy is an ailment not a human limitation but when peter's heart starts aching he just takes more medication and all the pain that's inside him masquerades as the things that define him. answers are elusive if you never ask the question, isolation with delusion breeds confusion and depression and all the joy they can believe in is ignored for the comforts that deceive them. honesty is humbling and none of us are blameless i don't propose perfection every small step is courageous and the emptiness that frustrates you has roots in the fear that separates you. love is so much larger than the words we use to say it and this song is just my love for you the best way i can display it, and all the love that you're hoarding, when shared becomes more rewarding.

lyrics.title: Based On Entirely Fictional Events And Nonexistant People
lyrics.text:
there was a fictional girl she was oppressed by the system and she wanted to change things and no one would listen so she took the bottle from the beer she'd been drinking and she filled it with gasoline said "that'll get 'em thinking" it took a lot more than fire for her to light up that fuse, but between nothing and flames it was easy to choose...and sometimes maybe we can not fix it and sometimes it must be erased...she usually preferred a more passive approach but she learned that destruction has its place. 
there was a fictional boy who was fighting the lies but they kept getting bigger despite all his tries and so he took the spray paint that he found in the shed and under cover of darkness he painted the town red, and sometimes maybe we can not fix it and sometimes it must be erased, though previously he had condemned it he now saw destruction's smiley face.. and the meek shall inherit nothing and private property is a myth, i usually prefer a more passive approach but i fear that it's come down to this.

lyrics.title: Human Rights Are More Important Than Living
lyrics.text:
i was a kid when i saw waco burn i couldn't grasp that i was seeing the denial of rights and the destruction of life, an inferno of human beings the news claimed fire was an accident but years later it came out "oops we slaughtered 25 children, what's all the fuss about?" i was working when the towers dropped, more tragedy sensationalized by the press, planes hijacked a terrorist attack, "we have to retaliate" you know the rest.."a justified reaction" said the puppets on t.v. but when they need to distract us from something else, from something worse, is that still what it will be? dollar signs drawn in blood and lies, painted on more faces every day, demand truth and resist tyranny and meet batons and pepper spray, "you must hate!" they've told us "we must make war and here is proof" but history shows it's not in their best interest to tell any of us the truth
tell us the truth
sometimes i cry in desperation, so many don't question or understand, whatever ugliness we're seeing now is just the tip of the ice berg of what is planned..
but i know people feel it near and far mines not the only heart that bleeds there's revolution sprouting everywhere and other lovers watering seeds and all of us are in teh danger zone for teh things we think and say and feel, but with every change we perpetrate, more beauty and truth are revealed. and when fighting for what you know is right it's not just your time and voice you're giving but  a big big love in all directions that says human rights are more important than living.

i don't wanna hear about your big dumb war, and i don't even watch your news anymore, it's obvious that blood and money bring you joy, but i don't make my choices based on advertising ploys..
and i believe in food not bombs and i believe in food not lawns and i believe that we can all be free, and i believe in no taxation and i believe in border less nations and i believe that anarchy is a key. i believe in critical mass that the e.l.f. is kicking ass and i believe we must destroy to build, and i believe in earth first a revolutionary rebirth and i believe if we want change we will, and i believe in community, i believe in diversity, and i believe in growing stuff in the dirt and i believe in shoplifting and i believe in dumpstering and i believe that squatting never hurts! and i wish the white house would burn down and fruit trees grow up from the ground to cover up the space that it was wasting! and no more bombs and no more guns and plenty of food for everyone and no more war and no more money, the promised land of milk and honey and i believe it's revolution we're facing.

lyrics.title: Do What You Want
lyrics.text:
When life makes no sense
and you do not have a chance
you are so low
left in pieces on the floor
It's your chance to mold
a pile of dirt into gold
you can go anywhere

when you've lost it all you're finally free to
do what you want, what you want to

It's when things go wrong
and your barely holding on
you're on the edge
hanging to it tight
every piece of gold
comes from stars that explode
i love your glow, it shimmers cause

when you've lost it all you're finally free to
do what you want, what you want to
